note: Test-id ledger for the engine-split Phase 1 batch 1a, built against the batch base 5871c748e. Ids are relative to each collection's ROOT, so the run names four roots per side. Run: node scripts/lib/test-parity.mjs --before <before-engine.json>=<base>/packages/engine --before <before-web.json>=<base>/apps/web --before <before-matrix.json>=<base>/tools/matrix --before <before-scripts.json>=<base> --after <after-engine.json>=packages/engine --after <after-scheduler.json>=packages/scheduler --after <after-web.json>=apps/web --after <after-matrix.json>=tools/matrix --after <after-scripts.json>=. --ledger this-file. Collect each side with `vitest run -t __parity_collect_only__ --reporter=json --outputFile <f>` from its root: engine (src/scheduling test/), scheduler (everything), apps/web (only the nine test files the batch touched or added: client-graph-no-server-barrel, swiss-pairing, schedule-solver-port-wiring, schedule-auto-solver-busy-latency, schedule-capacity-guard, schedule-court-candidates, schedule-court-hours, schedule-solver-telemetry, stage-round-court-tags), tools/matrix (__tests__/workspace-wiring.test.ts only), and the repo root (scripts/__tests__/tools-import-guard.test.ts only). NOT collectable by this script, accounted by hand in the 1a-4 report: scripts/__tests__/z3-retirement-drift.test.ts (pre-existing duplicate ids from truncated titles, which the script refuses; one title carries a repointed path and one test was added) and tools/matrix/__tests__/strip-types-loadable.test.ts (ids embed the absolute worktree path).
